items.t: Upstart Just Hit a New 52-Week Low After Falling 14% in a Month. Is the Selling Overdone?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysUpstart shares hit a new 52-week low on Tuesday and are down 14% in a month, after the company cut its 2026 outlook and rising Treasury yields hit consumer lenders including Affirm. The outlook cut is Upstart’s own problem: rising defaults are lowering the value of the loans it holds, even as Pagaya raised its 2026 profit forecast.
